author: /root/reserved_corpus

comparison_semantics.contexts: Available options, profile/qualified/retained/roots and embedded config context retained as hashes. Schemas differ and some ledgers omit filename/roots/options; cross-schema full-context equivalence is not claimed.
comparison_semantics.file_map: Sorted compact UTF-8 JSON of logical path -> raw-byte SHA-256; normalize only leading /repo/ virtual prefix or ./; no alpha-renaming or content normalization.
comparison_semantics.pathless_map: Sorted multiset of every file hash in a recorded map; a coincidence ignores logical paths and cannot establish contextual input identity.
comparison_semantics.raw_bytes: UTF-8 encode source text recorded in JSON; declared source hashes and integrated base64 bytes independently checked.
comparison_semantics.single_file: Source/configuration/declaration byte identity is reported separately from full input-map equality. SDK identities are allowed shared inputs; short or frequent fragments remain explicit coincidences without an invented waiver.
comparison_semantics.string_leaves: Broad input/variant string-leaf comparison is a secondary scope; metadata and observations may coincide with source text and are not promoted into proven source contamination.

conclusion: Bounded byte-identity findings only; see explicit matches and coverage limits. No change to frozen qualification acceptance or denominator.
limitations: Enumerated JSON ledgers only; this is not an exhaustive extraction of embedded development sources from Rust. Additional Rust tests in src/main.rs or other modules without a JSON ledger remain outside the identity comparison.
A zero full-map match count does not prove semantic novelty, non-derivation, alpha-renaming disjointness, or independent authorship.
Actual JSON-recorded options and file maps were compared where available. Missing outer options, selected roots and logical filenames prevent universal full-input/context comparison.

Qualification scenarios with source reuse or observation-only variants do not all provide reconstructible complete file maps; primary source hashes and input string leaves remain separate bounded scopes.
No frozen qualification denominator, source input, expected output or reserved artifact was changed.
Reserved case inputs/expectations were neither read for this comparison nor disclosed.

metadata_exposure_transparency.exposure_scope: Four initial expected-index metadata records only, as reported by root; no corresponding input/query payload and no TDD use reported. The audit does not claim blinding for those metadata.

scope: Read-only identity comparison of enumerated new development JSON ledgers against frozen qualification input maps/primary source hashes and 354 execution-unit input projections. No candidate execution, producer edit, staging or expected-output change.
